In PRC-32 stage 1, MUR-22 changes into FAR-27.
In PRC-32 stage 2, FAR-27 changes into CYN-61.
In PRC-32 stage 4, LUM-53 changes into terminal marker RAV-85.

In PRC-46 stage 1, WAM-50 changes into SIV-14.
In PRC-46 stage 2, SIV-14 changes into HAP-19.
In PRC-46 stage 4, ZIR-52 changes into terminal marker LUM-77.
